messages:
Maya (CS): heads up — customer ACME reports users receiving trial credits twice after promo activation. ticket #CS-4682. link: https://support.redwood.ai/t/CS-4682 :eyes:
Alberto (Eng): can you paste the promo config they used? sounds like a scope/limit mismatch
Maya (CS): attaching what ops returned from their import log:
```
POST /v1/promos 200 OK
payload: {
  \"code\": \"ACME-TRIAL\",
  \"scope\": \"global\",
  \"redemption_limit\": null,
  \"start_time\": \"2026-12-01T00:00:00Z\",
  \"end_time\": \"2026-12-31T23:59:59Z\",
  \"eligible_tiers\": [\"startup\"]
}
```
Chris (Product): hm redemption_limit null is a problem — should be integer or omitted? also \"scope: global\" + eligible_tiers is contradictory
Sofia (Billing): we're seeing billing adjustments for ACME invoices on 2026-12-02, multiple refund credits. looks like the promo applied during account creation + a subsequent onboarding grant
Alberto (Eng): repro steps from our side: create new account via signup API, then call the onboarding grant endpoint. Because promo.scope==global it matches both flows. fix: scope should be \"campaign\" or add explicit \"apply_on\" flags.
Alberto (Eng): quick patch I want to push: validate redemption_limit integer and block null, and prefer eligible_tiers precedence over global scope. will open PR now.
Maya (CS): Customer timeline: they signed up 2026-12-01T02:14:03+01:00 (CET) — promo start_time was midnight UTC so it became active in their local night and applied on signup. they then triggered onboarding grant at 02:16 which didn't check previous grants.
ops-oncall: can we roll back the onboarding grant webhook for accounts created between 00:00-03:00 UTC on 2026-12-01? that's 18 users for ACME org.
Alberto (Eng): rollback would be messy. patch will be small: (1) enforce redemption_limit default=1 for trial promos, (2) add atomic check on grant endpoint: if promo already applied to account, skip. I'll deploy canary to staging then prod if green.
cs-bot: New ticket created: ENG-9807 (validate promo payloads + atomic grant check)
Sofia (Billing): please add a billing reconciliation ETA — we need a CSV of affected invoices to process refunds/credits.
Alberto (Eng): noted. collecting affected account ids now. will post CSV to /secure-share when ready.
Maya (CS): customer asked for ETA on fix and rollback status. can we give them a 6-8 hour ETA?
Alberto (Eng): aiming for a 4h canary -> 8h full prod deploy. communicate 6-8h OK. :thumbsup:
Chris (Product): add a docs/tips note: promo authors should not set scope=global for tiered promos; we'll add server-side validation too.
ops-oncall: monitoring alert created for unusual promo redemptions (rule: > 3 redemptions per account in 24h) — alert id MON-3321
Maya (CS): replying to customer: "we've identified a campaign configuration issue (scope vs eligible tiers + missing redemption_limit). engineering is deploying a fix; estimated resolution 6-8h. we'll follow up with invoice adjustments if needed"
Alberto (Eng): PR 2147 opened: enforce redemption_limit, apply atomic grant check. deploying to canary now.
cs-bot: Deploy started: canary -> ENG-2147 by alberto.eta 00:20
ops-oncall: canary healthy after 12m, no new duplicates on staging traffic. proceeding to prod roll.
Alberto (Eng): prod roll done. patch notes: default redemption_limit=1 for trial promos, reject payloads with conflicting scope+eligible_tiers.
Sofia (Billing): received CSV. processing credits for affected invoices — will create refund records for ACME and ping when complete.
Maya (CS): customer updated: they appreciate quick response; will wait for final confirmation on refunds.
Chris (Product): follow-up action: create a prompt in promo UI that warns when \"scope=global\" + \"eligible_tiers\" present. filed PX-1123.
Maya (CS): closing thread once billing confirms refunds. thanks everyone :rocket:
